description.sl: Kateri glagol gre s katero besedo: take a photo, ne *make a photo*; do your homework, make a decision, make a mistake, do the washing up, take a break. In frazni glagoli: put up with, run out of, come across.
description.de: Welches Verb zu welchem Wort passt: take a photo, nicht *make a photo*; do your homework, make a decision, make a mistake, do the washing up, take a break. Und Phrasal Verbs: put up with, run out of, come across.
description.it: Quale verbo va con quale parola: take a photo, non *make a photo*; do your homework, make a decision, make a mistake, do the washing up, take a break. E i phrasal verb: put up with, run out of, come across.
description.en: Which verb goes with which word: take a photo, do your homework, make a decision, make a mistake, do the washing up, take a break. And phrasal verbs: put up with, run out of, come across.

story.it: It's damson-picking day on the terraces. Sam takes a photo of everyone, then you all take a break by the beck. · Sulle terrazze è il giorno delle susine. Sam fa una foto a tutti, poi fate tutti una pausa vicino al torrente.
story.en: It's damson-picking day on the terraces. Sam takes a photo of everyone, then you all take a break by the beck.
